questions.question: Which annotation makes Spring check the rules on a request body parameter?
questions.explanation: @Valid on the parameter tells Spring to run the validator on that object before the method body starts.

questions.question: Which annotation rejects text that contains only spaces?
questions.explanation: @NotBlank rejects null, empty text and text made only of spaces. @NotNull and @NotEmpty accept a string of spaces.

questions.question: A booking record has @Min(1) @Max(6) on seats. A client sends seats 9 to a controller that returns the first message with status 400. Which text does the client see?
options: You can book at most 6 seats
questions.explanation: Nine is above the maximum of 6, so the @Max rule fails and its message is returned.

questions.question: In the clinic app, GET /appointments/slots?count=50 has @Max(10) on count. What status code does the client get?
questions.explanation: A broken rule on a request parameter is a client mistake, so Spring replies 400 Bad Request.

questions.question: A developer adds @NotBlank to fields of a request record, but blank names are still accepted. The controller has @RequestBody AppointmentRequest request. What is missing?
questions.explanation: Constraint annotations are only checked when the parameter is marked with @Valid or @Validated.
